rows.grounds: primary noun denoting the energy center
numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing lotus petals
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What epithet, petal count, and structure define the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
It is described with the epithet royal.
It has eight petals and includes a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is the royal center, characterized by eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific name associated with rājānam in this tradition is not stated explicitly.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
